model_settings.value: Vertex-wise general linear models regressed out age and gender as covariates. Cortical thickness measures were smoothed with a 10 mm FWHM Gaussian kernel, with results compared across 5, 15, 20, and 25 mm kernels. Group-difference z-statistic maps were corrected using 10,000 Gaussian simulations; cluster-forming threshold was p-uncorrected = 0.05 and significance required cluster-wise probability ≤ 0.001.
